title: Look Where Others Are Not Looking
primary_theme: Large Opportunities, Team Execution, and Contrarian Conviction
founder_lessons: Help investors understand how large the opportunity can become before discussing deal structure.
Demonstrate that the team can react to changing conditions and keep moving quickly.
Meet investors before raising so they can observe whether you deliver against goals.
Expect disagreement inside venture firms; conviction from a deal champion can matter as much as consensus.
notable_quotes: the first thing that drives me is the opportunity. And the next is, can this team execute work?
the broader, the diversity is the better decision-making.
How amazing would that be? Their experience and knowledge and depth could be useful.
